Name: Farm Animal Little Bread
Author: Ishrmla
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]我非常想要在农场里看见一些可爱的东西，所以制作了这个模组和另一个纸杯蛋糕模组！[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]可以在鸡舍养小面包了！通过不断增加好感，它会给你一些面粉、面包，甚至是奇怪的小面包！[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I really wanted to see some cute things on the farm, so I made this mod and another cupcake mod![/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]You can start raising little bread in the chicken coop! By constantly increasing its affection, it will give you some flour, bread, and even a strange bun![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]下载并解压到Mods文件夹中。[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download and unzip it into the Mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
需要SMAPI和Content Patcher

Manifest.Name: BreadinCoop
Manifest.Description: 在鸡舍中添加一种会掉落面粉和面包的小面包。
Manifest.Author: Ishr
